company.name: Kable
company.shortDescription: Kable helps developers to integrate usage-based billing, invoicing, analytics, and authentication functions to their API products.
company.description:
Kable makes it easy for developers to add usage-based billing and authentication to their API products with just three lines of code.

We handle everything from usage metering to invoicing. We allow you to define tailored pricing plans for each customer or even each API endpoint. We give your customers visibility into their own usage of your product, and alert them when they reach or approach thresholds. We also offer out-of-the-box API authentication and self-service key management, so you can deploy your API products without building infrastructure in-house.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,650,000, or 90.6% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,117,272 to $17,229,257, a 3.37x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 26 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 67 (-5).
